name: LT-11 GT 3 Smart Watch | 1.3 Touchscreen, Fitness Tracker, Heart Rate & Notifications
description:
The LT-11 GT 3 Smart Watch blends modern style with powerful features for fitness, health, and daily life. With a 1.3-inch full-touch display, it delivers smooth navigation and clear visuals. Track steps, calories, and workouts while monitoring heart rate in real-time. Stay connected with call, SMS, and app notifications, plus enjoy music control on your wrist. Built with IP67 water resistance, it’s perfect for workouts, rain, or everyday use.
Key Features
 1.3 responsive TFT touchscreen display
 Fitness tracking: steps, calories & distance
 Real-time heart rate monitoring for workouts
 Smart notifications: calls, SMS & social apps
 Music control directly from your wrist
 IP67 water-resistant for daily protection
Ingredients / Materials
ABS plastic, silicone strap, TFT display, electronic sensors
How to Use
 Power on the smartwatch and connect via Bluetooth
 Install the compatible app on your smartphone
 Sync for notifications, fitness, and health tracking
 Wear during workouts, daily activities, or casual use
Package Includes
 1 × LT-11 GT 3 Smart Watch
 1 × Magnetic Charging Cable
 1 × User Manual
